not character then return end

	if humanoid then

			activeReasons[RANGED_SHIFTLOCK_REASON] = nil

		end)

local function getMobileCrosshair()
	if mobileCrosshair and mobileCrosshair.Parent then
		return mobileCrosshair
	end
	mobileCrosshair = screenGui and screenGui:FindFirstChild("MobileCrosshair", true) :: GuiObject
	return mobileCrosshair
end

configureLegacyCrosshair = function()
	local crosshair = getMobileCrosshair()
	if not crosshair then return end
	local visible = not featureSwitch.Value and shouldShowRangedCombatUI()
	if visible then
		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if camera then
			local aimViewportPoint = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(camera.CFrame.Position + camera.CFrame.LookVector * 10)
			local topLeftInset = GuiService:GetGuiInset()
			crosshair.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			crosshair.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
				aimViewportPoint.X - topLeftInset.X,
				aimViewportPoint.Y - topLeftInset.Y
			)
		end
	end
	crosshair.Visible = visible
end

local function configureFireButton(fire:ImageButton)
	-- Preserve the authored mobile layout. This helper only configures behavior,
	-- never Position, Size, AnchorPoint, or SizeConstraint.
	fire.ZIndex = math.max(fire.ZIndex, 4)
	fire.Active = true
	local desc = fire:FindFirstChild("t_desc", true)
	if desc and desc:IsA("TextLabel") then
		desc.Text = "Fire"
	end
end

local function getFireButton()
	if fireButton and fireButton.Parent then
		configureFireButton(fireButton)
		return fireButton
	end
	fireButton = uiInteractiveMobile:FindFirstChild("Fire") :: ImageButton
	if fireButton then
		configureFireButton(fireButton)
		return fireButton
	end

	local template = uiInteractiveMobile:FindFirstChild("Reload") or uiInteractiveMobile:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ImageButton")
	if template and template:IsA("ImageButton") then
		fireButton = template:Clone()
		fireButton.Name = "Fire"
	else
		fireButton = Instance.new("ImageButton")
		fireButton.Name = "Fire"
		fireButton.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		local text = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		text.Name = "t_desc"
		text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		text.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		text.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		text.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.8, 0.8)
		text.TextScaled = true
		text.Parent = fireButton
	end
	fireButton.Visible = false
	fireButton.Parent = uiInteractiveMobile
	configureFireButton(fireButton)
	return fireButton
end

setFireVisible = function(visible:boolean)
	local fire = getFireButton()
	if fire then
		fire.Visible = isMobileInput() and featureSwitch.Value and visible
	end
end

stopShiftLock = function()
	if renderConnection then
		renderConnection:Disconnect()
		renderConnection = nil
	end
	if nativeModeActive or savedRotationType ~= nil or savedAutoRotate ~= nil or savedCameraOffset ~= nil then
		restoreNativeState()
	elseif humanoid and not legacyModeActive then
		humanoid:SetAttribute("RangedCameraOffset", nil)
	end
	if legacyModeActive and humanoid then
		humanoid.AutoRotate = true
		humanoid.CameraOffset = Vector3.zero
	end
	legacyModeActive = false
	configureLegacyCrosshair()
	updateButtonImage(false)
end

local function startShiftLock()
	finishPendingRestore()
	legacyModeActive = not featureSwitch.Value
	if featureSwitch.Value then
		applyNativeShoulderMode()
	end
	if renderConnection then return end
	renderConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not character or not character.Parent or not root or not root.Parent or not humanoid or not humanoid.Parent then
			bindCharacter(player.Character)
			if featureSwitch.Value then applyNativeShoulderMode() end
		end
		if not root or not humanoid then return end

		if featureSwitch.Value then
			if not nativeModeActive then
				applyNativeShoulderMode()
			end
			return
		end

		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not camera then return end
		local lookVector = camera.CFrame.LookVector
		local flatLook = Vector3.new(lookVector.X, 0, lookVector.Z)
		if flatLook.Magnitude > 0.001 then
			humanoid.AutoRotate = false
			humanoid.CameraOffset = LEGACY_CAMERA_OFFSET
			root.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position, root.Position + flatLook.Unit * LOOK_DISTANCE)
		end
		configureLegacyCrosshair()
	end)
	updateButtonImage(true)
end

refreshShiftLock = function()
	local active = shouldBeActive()
	local wantsNative = active and featureSwitch.Value
	local wantsLegacy = active and not featureSwitch.Value
	local alreadyCorrect = renderConnection ~= nil
		and ((wantsNative and nativeModeActive) or (wantsLegacy and legacyModeActive))
	if not alreadyCorrect then
		if renderConnection or nativeModeActive or legacyModeActive then
			stopShiftLock()
		end
		if active then
			startShiftLock()
		else
			stopShiftLock()
		end
	end
	configureLegacyCrosshair()
	if setFireVisible then
		setFireVisible(shouldShowRangedCombatUI())
	end
end

function MobileCameraFramework.Enable(reason:string?)
	if not isMobileInput() then return end
	local owner = reason or "Manual"
	activeReasons[owner] = true
	if owner == RANGED_SHIFTLOCK_REASON then
		manualDisabled = false
	end
	refreshShiftLock()
end

function MobileCameraFramework.Disable(reason:string?)
	local owner = reason or "Manual"
	activeReasons[owner] = nil
	if next(activeReasons) == nil then
		manualDisabled = false
	end
	refreshShiftLock()
end

function MobileCameraFramework.ToggleManual()
	if not isMobileInput() then return end
	if shouldBeActive() then
		manualDisabled = true
		refreshShiftLock()
	else
		manualDisabled = false
		if next(activeReasons) == nil then
			activeReasons.Manual = true
		end
		refreshShiftLock()
	end
end

function MobileCameraFramework.IsActive()
	return renderConnection ~= nil
end

local function onEquipTool(_, tool:Tool)
	if not isMobileInput() then return end
	if isRangedWeapon(tool) then
		MobileCameraFramework.Enable(RANGED_SHIFTLOCK_REASON)
	end
end

local function onUnequipTool(_, tool:Tool)
	if not isMobileInput() then return end
	if isRangedWeapon(tool) then
		MobileCameraFramework.Disable(RANGED_SHIFTLOCK_REASON)
	end
end

local function onPreferredInputChanged()
	button.Visible = isMobileInput()
	refreshShiftLock()
	if not isMobileInput() then
		setFireVisible(false)
		local crosshair = getMobileCrosshair()
		if crosshair then crosshair.Visible = false end
	end
end

button.Visible = isMobileInput()
button:SetAttribute("ShiftLockActive", false)
button:SetAttribute("ManualDisabled", false)
bindCharacter(player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait())
getFireButton()
configureLegacyCrosshair()
updateButtonImage(false)

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newCharacter)
	bindCharacter(newCharacter)
	refreshShiftLock()
end)
UserInputService:GetPropertyChangedSignal("PreferredInput"):Connect(onPreferredInputChanged)
featureSwitch.Changed:Connect(function()
	button.Visible = isMobileInput()
	refreshShiftLock()
end)
button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(MobileCameraFramework.ToggleManual)
ToolHelper.onEquipTool.Event:Connect(onEquipTool)
ToolHelper.onUnequipTool.Event:Connect(onUnequipTool)

script.Destroying:Connect(function()
	if renderConnection then
		renderConnection:Disconnect()
		renderConnection = nil
	end
	if nativeModeActive or savedRotationType ~= nil or savedAutoRotate ~= nil or savedCameraOffset ~= nil then
		restoreNativeState(true)
	else
		cancelOffsetTween()
		unbindOffsetRender()
		if humanoid then
			humanoid:SetAttribute("RangedCameraSession", nil)
			humanoid:SetAttribute("RangedCameraOffset", nil)
		end
	end
	if humanoidDiedConnection then
		humanoidDiedConnection:Disconnect()
		humanoidDiedConnection = nil
	end
end)

return MobileCameraFramework

local CommonFunc = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("framework"):WaitForChild("CommonFunc"))
local ConfigHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("framework"):WaitForChild("ConfigHelper"))
local CommonEnum = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Common"):WaitForChild("CommonEnum"))
local DataHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Common"):WaitForChild("DataHelper"))
local CharaterSetting = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("ExcelConfig"):WaitForChild("CharaterSetting"))
local CharaterUpgradeSetting = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("ExcelConfig"):WaitForChild("CharaterUpgradeSetting"))
local CharaterStatsSetting = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("ExcelConfig"):WaitForChild("CharaterStatsSetting"))
local DailyQuestsSetting = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("ExcelConfig"):WaitForChild("DailyQuestsSetting"))

local panel = script.Parent
local title: TextLabel = panel:WaitForChild("t_title")
local subtitle: TextLabel = panel:WaitForChild("t_subtitle")
local tasksFrame: Frame = panel:WaitForChild("Tasks")
local taskPrefab: Frame = tasksFrame:WaitForChild("TaskPrefab")

title.Active = true
taskPrefab.Visible = false
taskPrefab.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)

for _, child in ipairs(tasksFrame:GetChildren()) do
	if child:IsA("GuiObject") and child.Name == "TaskPrefab" and child ~= taskPrefab then
		child:Destroy()
	end
end

local detailsVisible = false

local dailyClassOrder = {
	CommonEnum.DailyQuestsClasses.strategy,
	CommonEnum.DailyQuestsClasses.survival,
	CommonEnum.DailyQuestsClasses.craft,
}

local function getOrCreateTaskItem(index: number): Frame
	local item = tasksFrame:FindFirstChild(tostring(index))
	if item and item:IsA("Frame") then
		return item
	end

	item = taskPrefab:Clone()
	item.Name = tostring(index)
	item.LayoutOrder = index
	item.Parent = tasksFrame
	return item
end

local function hideTaskItems(fromIndex: number)
	for _, child in ipairs(tasksFrame:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("GuiObject") and child ~= taskPrefab then
			local index = tonumber(child.Name)
			if index and index >= fromIndex then
				child.Visible = false
			end
		end
	end
end

local function setSectionItem(index: number, sectionText: string)
	local item = getOrCreateTaskItem(index)
	local desc: TextLabel? = item:FindFirstChild("t_desc") :: TextLabel?
	local value: TextLabel? = item:FindFirstChild("t_value") :: TextLabel?
	local tick: GuiObject? = item:FindFirstChild("img_tick") :: GuiObject?

	item.Visible = detailsVisible
	if desc then
		desc.Text = sectionText
	end
	if value then
		value.Visible = false
	end
	if tick then
		tick.Visible = false
	end
end

local function setTaskItem(index: number, descText: string, curValue: number, targetValue: number, completed: boolean)
	local item = getOrCreateTaskItem(index)
	local desc: TextLabel? = item:FindFirstChild("t_desc") :: TextLabel?
	local value: TextLabel? = item:FindFirstChild("t_value") :: TextLabel?
	local tick: GuiObject? = item:FindFirstChild("img_tick") :: GuiObject?

	item.Visible = detailsVisible
	if desc then
		desc.Text = descText
	end
	if tick then
		tick.Visible = completed
	end
	if value then
		value.Visible = not completed
		value.Text = string.format("%d/%d", curValue, targetValue)
	end
end

local function getUpgradeQuest(characterLo, level: number)
	if not characterLo or level >= 3 then
		return nil
	end

	local upgradeLo = ConfigHelper:GetById(CharaterUpgradeSetting, characterLo.missionId)
	if not upgradeLo then
		return nil
	end

	local questStr = level == 1 and upgradeLo.Level2Quest or upgradeLo.Level3Quest
	if not questStr then
		return nil
	end

	return CommonFunc:ParseKV_Number(questStr)
end

local function collectCharacterTasks()
	local rows = {}
	local completedCount = 0
	local totalCount = 0

	local playerVo = DataHelper:GetPlayerVo()
	local characterId = playerVo and playerVo.characterId
	if not characterId then
		table.insert(rows, { desc = "No Character Equipped", cur = 0, target = 0, completed = false })
		return rows, completedCount, totalCount
	end

	local characterVo = DataHelper:GetCharacterVo(nil, characterId)
	local characterLo = ConfigHelper:GetById(CharaterSetting, characterId)
	if not characterVo or not characterLo then
		table.insert(rows, { desc = "No Character Equipped", cur = 0, target = 0, completed = false })
		return rows, completedCount, totalCount
	end

	if characterVo.lv >= 3 then
		table.insert(rows, { desc = "Max Level", cur = 1, target = 1, completed = true })
		return rows, 1, 1
	end

	local quest = getUpgradeQuest(characterLo, characterVo.lv)
	if not quest then
		table.insert(rows, { desc = "No Character Quest", cur = 0, target = 0, completed = false })
		return rows, completedCount, totalCount
	end

	for statsName, targetValue in pairs(quest) do
		local statsLo = ConfigHelper:GetById(CharaterStatsSetting, statsName)
		local curValue = tonumber(DataHelper:GetCharacterStats(nil, characterVo.id, statsName)) or 0
		local safeTarget = math.max(tonumber(targetValue) or 0, 0)
		local completed = safeTarget <= 0 or curValue >= safeTarget

		totalCount += 1
		if completed then
			completedCount += 1
		end

		table.insert(rows, {
			desc = statsLo and statsLo.desc or tostring(statsName),
			cur = curValue,
			target = safeTarget,
			completed = completed,
		})
	end

	return rows, completedCount, totalCount
end

local function collectDailyTasks()
	local rows = {}
	local completedCount = 0
	local totalCount = #dailyClassOrder
	local playerVo = DataHelper:GetPlayerVo()
	local records = playerVo and playerVo.dailyQuestsRecords

	for _, className in ipairs(dailyClassOrder) do
		local dailyQuestVo = records and records[className]
		local descText = string.format("%s: No Quest", tostring(className))
		local curValue = 0
		local targetValue = 0
		local completed = false

		if dailyQuestVo and dailyQuestVo.questId then
			local lo = ConfigHelper:GetById(DailyQuestsSetting, dailyQuestVo.questId)
			if lo then
				targetValue = math.max(tonumber(lo.times) or 0, 0)
				curValue = tonumber(dailyQuestVo.progress) or 0
				completed = targetValue <= 0 or curValue >= targetValue
				descText = lo.desc or tostring(dailyQuestVo.questId)
			else
				descText = string.format("%s: Invalid Quest", tostring(className))
			end
		end

		if completed then
			completedCount += 1
		end

		table.insert(rows, {
			desc = descText,
			cur = curValue,
			target = targetValue,
			completed = completed,
		})
	end

	return rows, completedCount, totalCount
end

local function renderRows(characterRows, dailyRows)
	local index = 0
	index += 1
	setSectionItem(index, "Character Tasks")
	for _, row in ipairs(characterRows) do
		index += 1
		setTaskItem(index, row.desc, row.cur, row.target, row.completed)
	end

	index += 1
	setSectionItem(index, "Daily Quests")
	for _, row in ipairs(dailyRows) do
		index += 1
		setTaskItem(index, row.desc, row.cur, row.target, row.completed)
	end

	hideTaskItems(index + 1)
	tasksFrame.Visible = detailsVisible
end

local function refresh()
	title.Text = "Quest List"

	if not DataHelper:IsInit() then
		subtitle.Text = "Loading..."
		hideTaskItems(1)
		tasksFrame.Visible = false
		return
	end

	local characterRows, characterCompleted, characterTotal = collectCharacterTasks()
	local dailyRows, dailyCompleted, dailyTotal = collectDailyTasks()

	subtitle.Text = string.format("Character %d/%d | Daily %d/%d", characterCompleted, characterTotal, dailyCompleted, dailyTotal)
	renderRows(characterRows, dailyRows)
end

local function toggleDetails()
	detailsVisible = not detailsVisible
	refresh()
end

title.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		toggleDetails()
	end
end)

DataHelper.onInitPlayerVo.Event:Connect(refresh)
DataHelper.onPlayerVoChanged.Event:Connect(refresh)
DataHelper.onCharacterIdChanged.Event:Connect(refresh)
DataHelper.onCharacterVoChanged.Event:Connect(refresh)

refresh()

local craftingBench:Model = MapHelper:GetCraftingBench() -- 工作台控制器
local v_level:IntValue = ValueHelper:WaitValue(craftingBench, CraftingBenchValue.level) -- 控制台等级
local v_wood:IntValue = ValueHelper:WaitValue(craftingBench, CraftingBenchValue.wood) -- 已储存的木材
local v_iron:IntValue = ValueHelper:WaitValue(craftingBench, CraftingBenchValue.iron) -- 已储存的铁
local v_gold:IntValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(craftingBench, CraftingBenchValue.gold)
local v_crystal:IntValue = ValueHelper:FindValue(craftingBench, CraftingBenchValue.crystal)

local btn_Close:GuiButton = script.Parent.RootFrame.Items.btn_Close

local mainUI = script.Parent:WaitForChild('RootFrame'):WaitForChild('Items')
local itemArr = mainUI:WaitForChild('CraftList'):WaitForChild('MyItem'):GetChildren()
local itemPerfab =mainUI:WaitForChild('ItemPrefab')

local woodValIcon = mainUI:WaitForChild('Resource'):WaitForChild('wood')
local IronvalIcon= mainUI:WaitForChild('Resource'):WaitForChild('iron')
local goldValIcon = mainUI:WaitForChild('Resource'):WaitForChild('gold')
local crystalValIcon = mainUI:WaitForChild('Resource'):WaitForChild('crystal')


local selectItemCraft
local selectItemBtn

-- 手柄导航状态
local currentSelectedIndex = 1
local allVisibleItems = {}
local selectedHighlight = nil
local waitCraft = true

local ScrollingFrame:ScrollingFrame = mainUI.CraftList
local ItemParent:Frame = ScrollingFrame.MyItem
ItemParent:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function() 
	local AbsoluteSize = ItemParent.AbsoluteSize
	ScrollingFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0,AbsoluteSize.Y)	
end)

local allItemCollect = {}
local _isInit = false

-- 获取所有可见且可选择的物品
local function getAllVisibleItems()
	local items = {}
	for _, canvasGroup in ipairs(itemArr) do
		if canvasGroup:IsA('CanvasGroup') and canvasGroup.Visible then
			for _, item in ipairs(canvasGroup:GetChildren()) do
				if item:IsA('ImageButton') and item.Visible and not item.img_Hide.Visible then
					table.insert(items, item)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return items
end

-- 创建高亮框
local function createHighlight()
	if selectedHighlight then return end
	
	selectedHighlight = Instance.new("Frame")
	selectedHighlight.Name = "GamepadHighlight"
	selectedHighlight.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	selectedHighlight.ZIndex = 10
	selectedHighlight.Parent = ScrollingFrame
	
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 100)
	stroke.Thickness = 3
	stroke.Parent = selectedHighlight
	
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	corner.Parent = selectedHighlight
	
	-- 添加 GamepadOnly 标签，手柄断开时自动隐藏
	local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
	CollectionService:AddTag(selectedHighlight, "GamepadOnly")
end

-- 高亮当前选中的物品
local function highlightSelectedItem()
	if not selectedHighlight then
		createHighlight()
	end
	
	allVisibleItems = getAllVisibleItems()
	
	if #allVisibleItems == 0 then
		selectedHighlight.Visible = false
		return
	end
	
	-- 确保索引在有效范围内
	if currentSelectedIndex < 1 then
		currentSelectedIndex = #allVisibleItems
	elseif currentSelectedIndex > #allVisibleItems then
		currentSelectedIndex = 1
	end
	
	local selectedItem = allVisibleItems[currentSelectedIndex]
	if selectedItem then
		selectedHighlight.Visible = true

		-- 用绝对坐标换算光标在 ScrollingFrame 画布中的位置
		local itemAbs = selectedItem.AbsolutePosition
		local scrollAbs = ScrollingFrame.AbsolutePosition
		local canvas = ScrollingFrame.CanvasPosition
		local relX = itemAbs.X - scrollAbs.X + canvas.X
		local relY = itemAbs.Y - scrollAbs.Y + canvas.Y
		selectedHighlight.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(selectedItem.AbsoluteSize.X, selectedItem.AbsoluteSize.Y)
		selectedHighlight.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(relX, relY)

		-- 自动滚动到选中项
		local itemPosY = itemAbs.Y
		local itemSizeY = selectedItem.AbsoluteSize.Y
		local scrollPosY = scrollAbs.Y
		local scrollSizeY = ScrollingFrame.AbsoluteSize.Y
		if itemPosY < scrollPosY then
			ScrollingFrame.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, canvas.Y - (scrollPosY - itemPosY) - 10)
		elseif itemPosY + itemSizeY > scrollPosY + scrollSizeY then
			ScrollingFrame.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, canvas.Y + (itemPosY + itemSizeY - scrollPosY - scrollSizeY) + 10)
		end
	else
		selectedHighlight.Visible = false
	end
end

local selectCurrentItem

-- 手柄导航：向上
local function navigateUp()
	allVisibleItems = getAllVisibleItems()
	if #allVisibleItems == 0 then return end
	
	currentSelectedIndex = currentSelectedIndex - 1
	if currentSelectedIndex < 1 then
		currentSelectedIndex = #allVisibleItems -- 循环到最后
	end
	
	highlightSelectedItem()
	selectCurrentItem()
end

-- 手柄导航：向下
local function navigateDown()
	allVisibleItems = getAllVisibleItems()
	if #allVisibleItems == 0 then return end
	
	currentSelectedIndex = currentSelectedIndex + 1
	if currentSelectedIndex > #allVisibleItems then
		currentSelectedIndex = 1 -- 循环到开头
	end
	
	highlightSelectedItem()
	selectCurrentItem()
end

-- 手柄选择当前物品
selectCurrentItem = function()
	allVisibleItems = getAllVisibleItems()
	if #allVisibleItems == 0 then return end
	
	local temp = allVisibleItems[currentSelectedIndex]
	if not temp or temp.img_Hide.Visible then
		return
	end
	
	-- 获取物品ID和数据
	local itemId = tonumber(temp.Name)
	if not itemId then return end
	
	local item:CraftItemSetting.Type = ConfigHelper:GetById(CraftItemSetting, itemId)
	if not item then return end
	
	-- 执行与 Activated 事件相同的逻辑（第332-370行）
	selectItemCraft = item.id
	selectItemBtn = temp
	
	mainUI:WaitForChild('Right').Visible = true
	mainUI:WaitForChild('Right').t_Name.Text = item.ItemName
	mainUI:WaitForChild('Right').Icon.Image = item.icon
	mainUI:WaitForChild('Right'):WaitForChild('Detail'):WaitForChild('t_value').Text = item.ItemDesc
	
	for a,b in ipairs(mainUI:WaitForChild('Right').Price:GetChildren()) do
		if b:IsA('Frame') then
			b:Destroy()
		end
	end

	for c,d in ipairs(temp.Price:GetChildren()) do
		if d:IsA('Frame') then
			local priceClone = d:Clone()
			priceClone.Parent = mainUI:WaitForChild('Right').Price
		end
	end

	if temp.img_lock.Visible then
		mainUI:WaitForChild('Right'):WaitForChild('btn_Craft').Visible = false

local function triggerCraft()
	if not selectItemCraft or not waitCraft then return end
	local btnCraft = mainUI:WaitForChild('Right'):WaitForChild('btn_Craft')
	if not mainUI:WaitForChild('Right').Visible or not btnCraft.Visible then return end

	waitCraft = false
	local craftTimes = CraftItemHelper:GetMakeTimes(selectItemCraft)
	local item:CraftItemSetting.Type = ConfigHelper:GetById(CraftItemSetting, selectItemCraft)

	if craftTimes.Value >= item.ItemLimit then
		UIHelper:PopCenterTips("Craft reach to limit")
		AudioHelper:PlayEffect("UIError")
	else
		local success = GameHelper.MakeCraftItemC2S:InvokeServer(selectItemCraft)

		if item.ItemLimit == 999 then
			selectItemBtn:WaitForChild('ItemLimit'):WaitForChild('t_Limit').Text = '∞'
		else
			selectItemBtn:WaitForChild('ItemLimit'):WaitForChild('t_Limit').Text = tostring(item.ItemLimit - craftTimes.Value)
			if craftTimes.Value >= item.ItemLimit then
				selectItemBtn:WaitForChild('soldPrefab').Visible = true
			end
		end

		if success then
			AudioHelper:PlayEffect("WorkShopCrafted")
			craftTimes = CraftItemHelper:GetMakeTimes(selectItemCraft)
			if craftTimes.Value >= item.ItemLimit then
				mainUI:WaitForChild('Right'):WaitForChild('btn_Craft').Visible = false
				mainUI:WaitForChild('Right'):WaitForChild('btn_Limit').Visible = true
			else
				mainUI:WaitForChild('Right'):WaitForChild('btn_Craft').Visible = true
				mainUI:WaitForChild('Right'):WaitForChild('btn_Limit').Visible = false
			end
		else
			AudioHelper:PlayEffect("UIError")
		end
	end

	task.wait(0.2)
	waitCraft = true
	checkVal()
	refreshCraftTime()
end

local function handleGamepadAction(actionName, inputState, inputObject)
	if inputState ~= Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
		return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
	end
	local keyCode = inputObject.KeyCode
	if keyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB then
		script.Parent.RootFrame.Visible = false
		workspace.Camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
	elseif keyCode == Enum.KeyCode.DPadUp or keyCode == Enum.KeyCode.DPadLeft then
		navigateUp()
	elseif keyCode == Enum.KeyCode.DPadDown or keyCode == Enum.KeyCode.DPadRight then
		navigateDown()
	elseif keyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA then
		triggerCraft()
	end
	return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
end

local function bindGamepadActions()
	ContextActionService:BindActionAtPriority(
		GAMEPAD_ACTION_NAME,
		handleGamepadAction,
		false,
		Enum.ContextActionPriority.High.Value,
		Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB,
		Enum.KeyCode.DPadUp,
		Enum.KeyCode.DPadDown,
		Enum.KeyCode.DPadLeft,
		Enum.KeyCode.DPadRight,
		Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA
	)
end

local function unbindGamepadActions()
	ContextActionService:UnbindAction(GAMEPAD_ACTION_NAME)
end

function onPlayerDeath(deadCharacter:Model)
	local isAllDied = true
	for _, player in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do 
		if not player.Character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.PlayerDeath) then
			isAllDied = false
			break
		end
	end

	if isAllDied then
		--没救了
		SelfDead.Visible = false
		if not AllDead.Visible then
			count = 30
			AllDead.Visible = true
			refreshCD()
		end
	else
		--local player = game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(deadCharacter)
		--如果有活的，那就有救
		if character == deadCharacter and not SelfDead.Visible then
			count = 30
			SelfDead.Visible = true
			refreshCD()
		end
	end	
end

function refreshCD()
	if AllDead.Visible then
		local t_cd:TextLabel = AllDead.t_cd
		t_cd.Text = string.format("Restart in: %d",count)
	elseif SelfDead.Visible then
		local t_cd = SelfDead.btn_selfRevive.t_cd
		t_cd.Text = string.format("Self-Revive( %d )",count)
	end
end

CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(GameEnum.Tag.PlayerDeath):Connect(onPlayerDeath)
game.Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player: Player) 
	onPlayerDeath()
end)

--开始计时
while true do
	wait(1)
	if AllDead.Visible then
		count -= 1

		if count <= 0 then
			AllDead.Visible = false
			GameHelper.TeleportToLobbyC2S:FireServer()
			break
		end
	elseif SelfDead.Visible then
		count -= 1
		
		if count <= 0 then
			SelfDead.Visible = false
		end
	end
	refreshCD()
end
